final_output:
# Incident Postmortem & Investigation Summary

## Executive Summary
An alert was triggered for elevated 5xx error rates (>5%) on `gateway /checkout`. The root cause was identified as deploy **D-2** of the `payments` service to version `v2`. Execution of `validate_v2` in version `v2` threw `UnsupportedCurrency: payment validation failed: unsupported currency EUR` on `/charge` requests, causing an upstream 5xx error cascade to `orders` and `gateway`. A rollback of `payments` to `v1` was executed, completely restoring error rates on all services to **0.0%**.

---

## Timeline
- **09:26:54.696Z** — Deploy **D-1** updates `orders` service from `v1` to `v1.1` `[E5]`.
- **09:27:44.712Z** — Deploy **D-2** updates `payments` service from `v1` to `v2` `[E3]`.
- **09:27:44.760Z (+0.048s after D-2)** — First occurrence of novel INFO log template `T17` (`fast-path validation passed for currency <*>`) on `payments-v2` `[E4]`.
- **09:27:45.287Z (+0.575s / +0.6s offset after D-2)** — Metric changepoint detected on `error_rate{route="/charge",service="payments"}` spiking from 0.0 to 18.27% (`z=25.5`) `[E2]`.
- **09:27:45.287Z (+0.575s after D-2)** — First occurrence of novel ERROR log template `T21` (`payment validation failed: unsupported currency EUR req=<*>`) on `payments-v2` `[E1]`.
- **09:27:45.294Z–09:27:45.298Z** — Error cascade propagates upstream to `orders` (`T20`: `payments charge failed with HTTP 500`) and `gateway` (`T18`: `checkout failed: orders returned HTTP 500`) `[E1, E2]`.
- **09:29:21.036Z** — Rollback request `c11e74f3-2a42-4f3b-8bd2-74c65e89a29e` executed, routing `payments` from `v2` back to `v1` (deploy **D-3**) `[E3, E6, E8]`.
- **09:29:21Z–09:29:58Z** — Verification telemetry confirms 5xx error rates dropped to 0.0% across all services `[E6, E7, E8, E9, E10, E11]`.

---

## Root Cause
- **Primary Cause**: Deploy **D-2** introduced version `v2` of `payments` `[E3]`. The new `validate_v2` function in `/app/payments/app.py` line 66 strictly validates currency and raises `UnsupportedCurrency` for incoming `EUR` transaction payloads `[E1]`.
- **Causal / Correlational Label**: Deploy-then-error timing is **correlational** (+0.6s offset between deploy D-2 at 09:27:44.712Z `[E3]` and error onset at 09:27:45.287Z `[E1, E2]`). Controlled causal replay is not available in this engine version.
- **Cascade Mechanism**: `payments` returning 500 HTTP status on `/charge` caused `orders` to fail `/orders` requests with HTTP 500 (`T20`), which in turn caused `gateway` to return HTTP 500 on `/checkout` (`T18`) `[E1, E2]`.

---

## Evidence Index
- **`E1`**: Novel ERROR log template `T21` (`payment validation failed: unsupported currency EUR req=<*>`) first seen on `payments-v2` at `2026-08-29T09:27:45.287Z` with full stack trace pointing to `/app/payments/app.py:66` in `validate_v2`.
- **`E2`**: Metric changepoint on `error_rate{route="/charge",service="payments"}` rising from baseline `0.0` to `0.1827` (`z=25.5`) starting at `2026-08-29T09:27:45.287Z`, with nearest deploy `D-2` (+0.6s offset), cascading to `orders` and `gateway`.
- **`E3`**: Deploy event `D-2` by `deploy-bot` deploying `payments` from `v1` to `v2` at `2026-08-29T09:27:44.712Z`.
- **`E4`**: Novel INFO log template `T17` (`fast-path validation passed for currency <*>`) on `payments-v2` first seen at `2026-08-29T09:27:44.760Z`.
- **`E5`**: Deploy event `D-1` by `ci-bot` deploying `orders` from `v1` to `v1.1` at `2026-08-29T09:26:54.696Z`.
- **`E6`**: Error delta check #1 (`2026-08-29T09:28:21Z` vs `2026-08-29T09:29:21Z–09:29:51Z`): `gateway` 5xx error rate dropped from 18.66% (111 errors / 595 reqs) to 0.0% (0 errors / 300 reqs).
- **`E7`**: Error delta check #1: `orders` 5xx error rate dropped from 18.66% (111 errors / 595 reqs) to 0.0% (0 errors / 300 reqs).
- **`E8`**: Error delta check #1: `payments` 5xx error rate dropped from 19.07% (111 errors / 582 reqs) to 0.0% (0 errors / 295 reqs).
- **`E9`**: Error delta check #2 (`2026-08-29T09:28:21Z` vs `2026-08-29T09:29:21Z–09:29:55.766Z`): `gateway` 5xx error rate sustained at 0.0% (0 errors / 348 reqs).
- **`E10`**: Error delta check #2: `orders` 5xx error rate sustained at 0.0% (0 errors / 348 reqs).
- **`E11`**: Error delta check #2: `payments` 5xx error rate sustained at 0.0% (0 errors / 342 reqs).

---

## Rejected Hypotheses
- **Hypothesis 2: Deploy D-1 of `orders` service caused the failure `[E5]`**
  - *Rejection Reason*: Deploy **D-1** (`orders` v1.1) occurred at `09:26:54.696Z` `[E5]`, over 50 seconds prior to error onset at `09:27:45.287Z` `[E1, E2]`. In addition, exception stack traces in `E1` pinpoint error origin inside `payments-v2` (`/app/payments/app.py:66`).

---

## Remediation Action & Verification
- **Action Taken**: Rollback executed for service `payments` from `v2` to `v1`.
  - **Deploy ID**: `D-3` `[E3]`
  - **Request ID**: `c11e74f3-2a42-4f3b-8bd2-74c65e89a29e`
  - **Justification Evidence IDs**: `[E1, E2, E3]`
- **Verification**:
  - **Check 1 (30s post-rollback)**: 5xx error rates dropped to **0.0%** across `gateway`, `orders`, and `payments` `[E6, E7, E8]`.
  - **Check 2 (38s post-rollback)**: 5xx error rates remained sustained at **0.0%** across all services over 348 requests `[E9, E10, E11]`. System has fully recovered.

---

## Freshness Caveats
- Initial watermark check showed `lag_ms = 325 ms` (`wall_clock_now = 09:29:07.700Z`, newest log = `09:29:07.375Z`), indicating fully caught-up telemetry data.
- Post-action verification watermarks showed `lag_ms = 47 ms` and `247 ms`, confirming real-time telemetry ingestion during recovery verification without significant lag caveats.

# Incident Postmortem & Investigation Summary

## Executive Summary
An alert was triggered for elevated 5xx error rates (>5%) on `gateway /checkout`. The root cause was identified as deploy **D-2** of the `payments` service to version `v2`. Execution of `validate_v2` in version `v2` threw `UnsupportedCurrency: payment validation failed: unsupported currency EUR` on `/charge` requests, causing an upstream 5xx error cascade to `orders` and `gateway`. A rollback of `payments` to `v1` was executed, completely restoring error rates on all services to **0.0%**.

---

## Timeline
- **09:26:54.696Z** — Deploy **D-1** updates `orders` service from `v1` to `v1.1` `[E5]`.
- **09:27:44.712Z** — Deploy **D-2** updates `payments` service from `v1` to `v2` `[E3]`.
- **09:27:44.760Z (+0.048s after D-2)** — First occurrence of novel INFO log template `T17` (`fast-path validation passed for currency <*>`) on `payments-v2` `[E4]`.
- **09:27:45.287Z (+0.575s / +0.6s offset after D-2)** — Metric changepoint detected on `error_rate{route="/charge",service="payments"}` spiking from 0.0 to 18.27% (`z=25.5`) `[E2]`.
- **09:27:45.287Z (+0.575s after D-2)** — First occurrence of novel ERROR log template `T21` (`payment validation failed: unsupported currency EUR req=<*>`) on `payments-v2` `[E1]`.
- **09:27:45.294Z–09:27:45.298Z** — Error cascade propagates upstream to `orders` (`T20`: `payments charge failed with HTTP 500`) and `gateway` (`T18`: `checkout failed: orders returned HTTP 500`) `[E1, E2]`.
- **09:29:21.036Z** — Rollback request `c11e74f3-2a42-4f3b-8bd2-74c65e89a29e` executed, routing `payments` from `v2` back to `v1` (deploy **D-3**) `[E3, E6, E8]`.
- **09:29:21Z–09:29:58Z** — Verification telemetry confirms 5xx error rates dropped to 0.0% across all services `[E6, E7, E8, E9, E10, E11]`.

---

## Root Cause
- **Primary Cause**: Deploy **D-2** introduced version `v2` of `payments` `[E3]`. The new `validate_v2` function in `/app/payments/app.py` line 66 strictly validates currency and raises `UnsupportedCurrency` for incoming `EUR` transaction payloads `[E1]`.
- **Causal / Correlational Label**: Deploy-then-error timing is **correlational** (+0.6s offset between deploy D-2 at 09:27:44.712Z `[E3]` and error onset at 09:27:45.287Z `[E1, E2]`). Controlled causal replay is not available in this engine version.
- **Cascade Mechanism**: `payments` returning 500 HTTP status on `/charge` caused `orders` to fail `/orders` requests with HTTP 500 (`T20`), which in turn caused `gateway` to return HTTP 500 on `/checkout` (`T18`) `[E1, E2]`.

---

## Evidence Index
- **`E1`**: Novel ERROR log template `T21` (`payment validation failed: unsupported currency EUR req=<*>`) first seen on `payments-v2` at `2026-08-29T09:27:45.287Z` with full stack trace pointing to `/app/payments/app.py:66` in `validate_v2`.
- **`E2`**: Metric changepoint on `error_rate{route="/charge",service="payments"}` rising from baseline `0.0` to `0.1827` (`z=25.5`) starting at `2026-08-29T09:27:45.287Z`, with nearest deploy `D-2` (+0.6s offset), cascading to `orders` and `gateway`.
- **`E3`**: Deploy event `D-2` by `deploy-bot` deploying `payments` from `v1` to `v2` at `2026-08-29T09:27:44.712Z`.
- **`E4`**: Novel INFO log template `T17` (`fast-path validation passed for currency <*>`) on `payments-v2` first seen at `2026-08-29T09:27:44.760Z`.
- **`E5`**: Deploy event `D-1` by `ci-bot` deploying `orders` from `v1` to `v1.1` at `2026-08-29T09:26:54.696Z`.
- **`E6`**: Error delta check #1 (`2026-08-29T09:28:21Z` vs `2026-08-29T09:29:21Z–09:29:51Z`): `gateway` 5xx error rate dropped from 18.66% (111 errors / 595 reqs) to 0.0% (0 errors / 300 reqs).
- **`E7`**: Error delta check #1: `orders` 5xx error rate dropped from 18.66% (111 errors / 595 reqs) to 0.0% (0 errors / 300 reqs).
- **`E8`**: Error delta check #1: `payments` 5xx error rate dropped from 19.07% (111 errors / 582 reqs) to 0.0% (0 errors / 295 reqs).
- **`E9`**: Error delta check #2 (`2026-08-29T09:28:21Z` vs `2026-08-29T09:29:21Z–09:29:55.766Z`): `gateway` 5xx error rate sustained at 0.0% (0 errors / 348 reqs).
- **`E10`**: Error delta check #2: `orders` 5xx error rate sustained at 0.0% (0 errors / 348 reqs).
- **`E11`**: Error delta check #2: `payments` 5xx error rate sustained at 0.0% (0 errors / 342 reqs).

---

## Rejected Hypotheses
- **Hypothesis 2: Deploy D-1 of `orders` service caused the failure `[E5]`**
  - *Rejection Reason*: Deploy **D-1** (`orders` v1.1) occurred at `09:26:54.696Z` `[E5]`, over 50 seconds prior to error onset at `09:27:45.287Z` `[E1, E2]`. In addition, exception stack traces in `E1` pinpoint error origin inside `payments-v2` (`/app/payments/app.py:66`).

---

## Remediation Action & Verification
- **Action Taken**: Rollback executed for service `payments` from `v2` to `v1`.
  - **Deploy ID**: `D-3` `[E3]`
  - **Request ID**: `c11e74f3-2a42-4f3b-8bd2-74c65e89a29e`
  - **Justification Evidence IDs**: `[E1, E2, E3]`
- **Verification**:
  - **Check 1 (30s post-rollback)**: 5xx error rates dropped to **0.0%** across `gateway`, `orders`, and `payments` `[E6, E7, E8]`.
  - **Check 2 (38s post-rollback)**: 5xx error rates remained sustained at **0.0%** across all services over 348 requests `[E9, E10, E11]`. System has fully recovered.

---

## Freshness Caveats
- Initial watermark check showed `lag_ms = 325 ms` (`wall_clock_now = 09:29:07.700Z`, newest log = `09:29:07.375Z`), indicating fully caught-up telemetry data.
- Post-action verification watermarks showed `lag_ms = 47 ms` and `247 ms`, confirming real-time telemetry ingestion during recovery verification without significant lag caveats.
